comments.author: Mel
comments.body:
Discovery: The Colonnade

Description: The Hypostyle Hall of the Karnak temple has 134 standing stone pillars, with some all over 10 meters tall and some over 20 meters in height. They were commissioned by the ancient Egyptian pharaoh, Ramses II.

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body: Thank you. I am told that discovery cards like the one you transcribed will be fixed and returned from Japanese to English in the near future. Cheers.
